prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. One fully NEW and reimagined StarNet game prop. Reference 1 is approved crate: exact finish/readability standard. Reference 2 is approved workstation: exact camera and craft. Reference 3 is approved bridge: world context. Use these solely as style references. Do not copy the crate or desk silhouette. South-facing overhead oblique station camera, perfectly straight-on in horizontal alignment, NO yaw, no isometric diagonals: horizontal long edges, vertical supports, symmetrical foreshortening, top planes visible at the same angle as workstation reference. Worn cool charcoal steel, broad readable panels, deep recesses, sparse purposeful brass/amber edge wear. Retain clear major parts at tiny game scale; no overly intricate micro-machinery, no arbitrary blue paint or bright chrome. Entire single prop isolated with generous margin and true transparent alpha background. No checkerboard, floor, room, text, other props, label or framing. Design a new living STATION PLANT with identifiable organic silhouette. Narrow single tile floor footprint, about person shoulder height; total silhouette width:height approximately 0.55:1. One small industrial self-watering pot forms the bottom one-third, chamfered graphite steel shell and a broad inset pot opening with dark growing medium. Above it, one living sturdy stem with five generous distinct broad lance-shaped matte leaves, visibly individual leaves spreading asymmetrically yet fitting narrow silhouette. Natural restrained dark desaturated olive/forest greens with pale central veins, new botany suitable for a dim industrial station. Natural leaf color is functional and should NOT tint the steel pot. No alien glows, neon cyan foliage, vines, flowers or bushy masses of tiny leaves. Match the station's crisp textured game art; no photoreal studio photography. Top of pot at the reference camera angle, body grounded, plant readable at small size.
